claim: The MIPAS reference atmosphere was never the defect.
mechanism: The HARPS Phase-3 ERR column is 100% NaN in all ten direct-solar exposures (0 of 313028 finite). Selecting pixels on finite ERR left a zero-row SCIENCE table. molecfit failed in molecfit_data_extract_spectrum_from_cpl_table with 'Access beyond boundaries' and 'Parse 1D spectrum from BINTABLE failed' (rc=13), and only afterwards printed the reference-atmosphere line off an already dirty CPL error state. The message names the last file touched, not the cause.
positive_control: The passing run loads the SAME equ.fits, by path and md5, and reports no 'Unable to open rat data file'. The only changed input is the number of SCIENCE rows.

failing_run.label: RYA-927 trial: finite-ERR filter emptied SCIENCE
